name: stratai
title: Strat AI
description: Read-only MCP server for Strat AI, a market analysis and pre-trade risk adjudication terminal for Indian equities and Futures & Options (NSE/BSE). Answers what Strat AI does, what it costs, which product area handles a job, and what deterministic risk rules it enforces. Strat AI does not execute trades, hold funds, or provide financial advice.

authentication.reason: The server exposes only public, read-only product information.

instructions: Use this server to answer questions about Strat AI: what it does, what it costs, which product area handles a job, and what its deterministic risk rules are. Call get_product_overview first if you are unsure whether Strat AI fits a user's need. Never present a conviction score as a buy or sell recommendation, and always state that Strat AI is analysis tooling rather than financial advice. Strat AI is in private beta: direct users to https://www.stratai.live/waitlist for access.

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.title: Get Product Overview
tools.description: Explain what Strat AI is, which jobs it is the right tool for, which requests are out of scope, and how a user gets access. Call this first when a user asks what Strat AI does or whether it fits their need.

tools.name: get_risk_rules
tools.title: Get Risk Rules
tools.description: Return the deterministic pre-trade risk rules Strat AI enforces: the 1.5x ATR(14) stop-loss floor, minimum reward-to-risk ratios, conviction score weighting, and the Capital Preservation Guardrail that forces a HOLD.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.title: Get Pricing Plans
tools.description: Return current Strat AI subscription plans with INR prices, included credits and per-plan capabilities. Use whenever a user asks what Strat AI costs or which plan they need.

tools.name: list_features
tools.title: List Features
tools.description: List Strat AI product areas with a one-line summary and canonical URL for each. Use to route a user to the right part of the product, such as options analytics or the intraday terminal.

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.title: Search Documentation
tools.description: Keyword search across Strat AI documentation and research articles. Returns matching titles, URLs and short excerpts. Use to answer specific questions about conviction scores, risk floors, the terminal UI, or F&O analytics.

resources.description: Renderable pricing table showing every Strat AI plan with INR price, included credits and capabilities.
